svg.title: A state said by a mark under 3 to 1 is a state not said
svg.desc: Finding 11 · measured from the built-in theme · the dark scheme, glass over a white window, which is its worst A discussion mockup drawn by hand from the built-in theme's colours, not a screenshot.
svg.text: A state said by a mark under 3 to 1 is a state not said
Finding 11 · measured from the built-in theme · the dark scheme, glass over a white window, which is its worst
Five states told by faint marks
The same five, at 3 to 1 or by a shape
1 Which tab is shown, in a frame without focus
a white window behind the frame
The underline is --border: 1.2:1 here, 1.2 to 1.7 on any ground
The shown tab's title is as dim as the others'
Light scheme: 1.0 to 1.2. Known since 16 November (finding 28)
2 Whether a row of a menu is on
Cyan sign against white sign: 1.5:1; 1.5 to 2.3 for the six accents
ADR 70 weighed a tick and a switch, and left both
3 What Enter will take, in the launcher of pull request #177
1 unit of the accent at a fifth: 1.4:1 against the launcher
DESIGN.md: the accent means “this is what will happen”
The whole of the bar against the notice: 1.2:1; 1.1 to 1.6 on any
No number is written, and it is gone in a second and a half
5 A notification that is critical, and one with the keyboard
Critical: the 1 unit edge turns red, 2.9:1 here. Known, 16 November
The keyboard on it: the 1 unit edge turns the accent
DESIGN.md: “a mark as well as a red edge”, “a ring as well as a tint”
1 Which tab is shown, in a frame without focus
a white window behind the frame
The underline in the title's own colour, 3 units: 3.8:1 here
The shown tab's title heavier: weight, which needs no colour
With focus it is the accent, as it is today
2 Whether a row of a menu is on
The square against the menu: 4.9:1; the sign on it 10.3:1
A tick is a shape: read without any colour at all
The row's words stay the same either way, as ADR 70 wants
3 What Enter will take, in the launcher of pull request #177
2 units of the accent: 4.9:1 against the launcher
And the key written on the row, which needs no colour
The whole as a line round it: 3.6:1; how full, 4.9:1
The number written; shown as long as other notices are
5 A notification that is critical, and one with the keyboard
Critical: a sign before its title, and an edge 2 units thick
The keyboard: the ring of 2 units, 2 out, that buttons have
Both are what DESIGN.md already says they are
